column1: # Genetic codes 34-37: the four alternative bacterial codes of
# Shulgina & Eddy (2021), eLife 10:e71402, as tabulated by Wikipedia
# ("List of genetic codes"). NCBI has not adopted them and assigns no
# id past 33; 34-37 are Wikipedia's own numbering.
# One line per code: id<TAB>amino acid of each codon, in the codon order
# TTT TTC TTA TTG TCT ... GGG (the same order as NCBI's ncbieaa string).
